svg.title: Model scores across the three P3D-Bench tasks
svg.desc: Image/Assembly source: https://spatiaos.github.io/projects/P3D-Bench/ (snapshot 2026-09-15T23:01:23+08:00). Text uses the fixed-100 results reaggregated under the manuscript rules; Image and Assembly average geometry, aesthetics and semantic Judge axes. Task order: Assembly-3D, Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D. Panels use separately labeled, nonzero score ranges. Compare heights only within each panel. Labels round to one decimal. Model order and colors follow Assembly-3D.
